bio.text: Lauren McDonald III, a Republican, represents Georgia House District 26 and chairs the House Intragovernmental Coordination Committee; he was sworn in on January 11, 2021.

His official biography says he lives in Forsyth County and earned a bachelor's degree in political science from the University of Georgia and an associate's degree in mortuary science from Gupton-Jones College.
It says McDonald spent 27 years as a firefighter and EMT, including 23 years with the Forsyth County Fire Department, served 16 years as Forsyth County coroner, and is a partner in funeral homes.
